Seurat Technologies is an advanced contract manufacturer specializing in metal components, leveraging its proprietary Area Printing® technology. This innovative process enables serial production of high-volume, industrial-scale parts, delivering both high fidelity and significant throughput. It facilitates the efficient reshoring of demanding industrial manufacturing applications.

Founded in 2015 by James DeMuth, Seurat’s genesis originates from his co-invention of its core technology at Livermore Labs. DeMuth's insight centered on scaling 3D metal printing beyond prototyping, making it viable for mass production and widespread industrial adoption.

The company serves industrial clients, notably in automotive and energy sectors, seeking high-volume metal parts. Seurat's vision is to transform global manufacturing by providing a profitable, rapid, and resilient supply chain through localized Area Printing® factories, thereby empowering industrial innovation by overcoming existing additive manufacturing limitations.
